desc:
WHIPPED FROSTING: A delicious white frosting with a light, airy texture; Great for icing baked goods such as cakes, cupcakes, and cookies

QUICK AND EASY: Just pop open the can, spread the frosting, and enjoy

A TRUSTED FAVORITE: Makes a perfect base for sprinkles and other fun decorations; Try our frosting with other trusted favorites such as Betty Crocker Cake Mix or Brownie Mix

GLUTEN FREE: This gluten free frosting is an ideal pantry staple; Keep this Betty Crocker frosting on hand with baking supplies for your impromptu baking needs

CONTAINS: Eight 12 oz tubs of Betty Crocker Whipped Fluffy White Frosting
features:
Key Features:

Light & Airy Texture: Pre-whipped and soft, perfect for easy spreading and piping.

Classic Flavors: Available in vanilla or butter‑cream, providing smooth, familiar sweet tastes.

Gluten‑Free: Suitable for those avoiding gluten. 

Ready-to-Use: No mixing required—just open and frost. 

Pantry-Stable: Keeps until opened; refrigerate leftovers for up to two weeks.

 Benefits:

Effortless Decorating: The whipped texture spreads easily and works well for layering or piping without extra tools.

Less Overwhelming Sweetness: Its fluffiness softens the sugary taste, closer to homemade appeal.

Great for Casual & Kid-Friendly Desserts: Mild flavor and light texture make it ideal for cupcakes, party treats, and celebrations. 

Customizable: Can be lightly whipped further to enhance volume, or flavored with extracts and colors for visual flair.
ingredients: Sugar, Palm Oil, Water, Corn Syrup, Corn Starch. Contains 2% or less of: Monoglycerides, Cellulose Gel, Salt, Polysorbate 80, Sodium Acid Pyrophosphate, Cellulose Gum, Artificial Flavor, Citric Acid. Freshness Preserved by Potassium Sorbate.
